visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two animated characters with stout builds, wearing brown vests, green pants, and red hats, interact near a large grey off-road vehicle on a dirt path. The setting is a brightly lit outdoor environment with pine trees and rocky terrain. (2) A third character wearing a wide-brimmed brown hat and sunglasses sits in the driver's seat of a camper van, holding a steering wheel. The van is positioned on a high wooden ramp. (3) The character leaps or is launched from the high wooden structure into a vast valley. The camera tracks the rapid descent toward a body of water below. Distant mountains and a clear sky are visible. (4) Multiple characters gather on the edge of the wooden platform, performing exaggerated physical movements and falling into the abyss. Yellow and blue UI bars are visible at the top of the frame throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Multiple male voices speak Mandarin with high energy and casual slang. Low-frequency mechanical engine idling sounds are present in the background. (2) A sudden, high-pitched vocal scream erupts, reaching a high arousal peak. This is followed by rapid-fire laughter and loud exclamations. (3) A loud thud and crashing sound effect occurs, accompanied by overlapping voices shouting in excitement. The pitch variability is high as speakers react to a chaotic event. (4) Distinct splashing sounds and percussive thuds are heard as the voices continue to laugh hysterically. The speech rate is fast with many rising intonations. (5) Constant high-volume chatter and shouting continue until the end, with incidental rustling and impact noises mixed in.
